## About This Store

[[.Company.Name]] uses BusinessCart.ai for its online storefront. The store features:
- Direct checkout with secure payment processing
- Product categories for easy browsing
- Mobile-friendly design that works on any device
- Sub-1-second page load times
- All product data available in HTML and markdown formats for easy reading
